question: Why is protamine sulfate short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.
steps.finding: 2 stock lines across 2 hospitals, 1 presentation, in units of use.

steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

explanation.headline: Protamine sulfate is not on FDA's current shortage list; the earlier shortage posted 2021-04-20 is resolved

sentences.text: FDA's records show protamine sulfate is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21, and the earlier shortage first posted on 2021-04-20 has been resolved.
The product label links our supply to Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022), a registered plant.
FDA inspected that plant on 2020-05-18 and classified it OAI, 337 days before the 2021-04-20 shortage posting.
A later inspection on 2022-06-30 was also classified OAI, 436 days after the posting.
The most recent inspection on 2023-08-24 was classified VAI.
Corvale East has 31.1 days on hand and Corvale General has 14.9 days on hand for the 10 mg/mL, 5 mL vial presentation.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.
